abbrev solution : ℕ × ℕ := (3, 103)

abbrev ValidPair : ℕ × ℕ → Prop
| (m, n) => 1 ≤ m ∧ m < n ∧ (1978^m) % 1000 = (1978^n) % 1000

theorem imo1978_p1 (m n : ℕ)
    (hmn : (m, n) = solution) :
    ValidPair (m, n) ∧
    (∀ m' n' : ℕ, ValidPair (m', n') → m + n ≤ m' + n') := by 
  have h₁ : m = 3 := by
    simp [solution, Prod.ext_iff] at hmn
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₂ : n = 103 := by
    simp [solution, Prod.ext_iff] at hmn
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₃ : ValidPair (m, n) := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    constructor
    · 
      norm_num
    constructor
    · 
      norm_num
    · 
      norm_num [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod]
      <;>
      rfl
  
  have h₄ : ∀ m' n' : ℕ, ValidPair (m', n') → m + n ≤ m' + n' := by
    intro m' n' h
    have h₅ : m = 3 := h₁
    have h₆ : n = 103 := h₂
    rw [h₅, h₆]
    have h₇ : 1 ≤ m' := h.1
    have h₈ : m' < n' := h.2.1
    have h₉ : (1978^m') % 1000 = (1978^n') % 1000 := h.2.2
    have h₁₀ : 106 ≤ m' + n' := by
      by_contra h₁₀
      have h₁₁ : m' + n' < 106 := by linarith
      have h₁₂ : m' ≤ 105 := by omega
      have h₁₃ : n' ≤ 105 := by omega
      interval_cases m' <;> norm_num [ValidPair, Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod] at h₇ h₈ h₉ ⊢ <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try
          {
            interval_cases n' <;> norm_num [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod] at h₉ ⊢ <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try
                {
                  norm_num [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_mod] at h₉ ⊢ <;>
                    omega
                })
          })
      <;>
      omega
    linarith
  
  exact ⟨h₃, h₄⟩

theorem singapore2019_r1_p4 (x : ℝ) (hx : Real.logb 21 3 = x) :

    have h₁ : Real.logb 21 3 = x := hx
    have h₂ : Real.logb 21 3 = Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> norm_num
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    have h₃ : Real.log 3 / Real.log 21 = x := by linarith
    have h₄ : Real.log 21 ≠ 0 := by
      have h₅ : (21 : ℝ) > 1 := by norm_num
      have h₆ : Real.log 21 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
      linarith
    field_simp at h₃
    <;> nlinarith
  
  have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
    have h₂ : Real.log 21 = Real.log (3 * 7) := by norm_num
    rw [h₂]
    have h₃ : Real.log (3 * 7) = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    rw [h₃]
    <;>
    norm_num
  
  have h₃ : Real.log 3 = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
    have h₃ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h₂
    have h₄ : Real.log 3 = x * Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₅ : Real.log 3 = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := by
      rw [h₃] at h₄
      linarith
    exact h₅
  
  have h₄ : Real.log 3 * (1 - x) = x * Real.log 7 := by
    have h₄ : Real.log 3 = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
    have h₅ : Real.log 3 * (1 - x) = x * Real.log 7 := by
      
      have h₅ : Real.log 3 = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₄
      have h₆ : Real.log 3 * (1 - x) = x * Real.log 7 := by
        
        ring_nf at h₅ ⊢
        nlinarith
      exact h₆
    exact h₅
  
  have h₅ : x ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have h₅ : Real.log 3 = x * Real.log 21 := h₁
    have h₆ : x = 1 := h
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    have h₇ : Real.log 3 = Real.log 21 := by linarith
    have h₈ : (3 : ℝ) = 21 := by
      have h₉ : Real.log 3 = Real.log 21 := h₇
      have h₁₀ : Real.log 3 = Real.log 21 := h₉
      have h₁₁ : (3 : ℝ) = 21 := by
        
        apply Real.log_injOn_pos (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num)) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num))
        linarith
      exact h₁₁
    norm_num at h₈ <;> linarith
  
  have h₆ : 1 - x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h₆
    have h₇ : x = 1 := by linarith
    exact h₅ h₇
  
  have h₇ : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by
    have h₇ : Real.log 7 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
    have h₈ : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    exact h₈
  
  have h_main : Real.logb 7 9 = solution x := by
    have h₈ : Real.logb 7 9 = Real.log 9 / Real.log 7 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₈]
    have h₉ : Real.log 9 = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
      have h₉ : Real.log 9 = Real.log (3 ^ 2) := by norm_num
      rw [h₉]
      have h₁₀ : Real.log (3 ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log 3 := by
        rw [Real.log_pow] <;> norm_num
      rw [h₁₀]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₉]
    have h₁₀ : solution x = (2 * x) / (1 - x) := by
      simp [solution]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₁₀]
    have h₁₁ : (2 * Real.log 3) / Real.log 7 = (2 * x) / (1 - x) := by

      have h₁₃ : Real.log 21 = Real.log 3 + Real.log 7 := h₂
      have h₁₄ : Real.log 3 = x * (Real.log 3 + Real.log 7) := h₃
      have h₁₅ : Real.log 3 * (1 - x) = x * Real.log 7 := h₄
      have h₁₆ : 1 - x ≠ 0 := h₆
      have h₁₇ : Real.log 7 ≠ 0 := h₇
      field_simp [h₁₆, h₁₇] at h₁₂ h₁₃ h₁₄ h₁₅ ⊢
      nlinarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3), Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 7),
        Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 21)]

      have h₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c := by
        have h₁ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) = Real.log (a^a) + Real.log (b^b) + Real.log (c^c) := by
          rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          <;> ring
        rw [h₁]
        have h₂ : Real.log (a^a) = a * Real.log a := by
          rw [Real.log_rpow ha]
        have h₃ : Real.log (b^b) = b * Real.log b := by
          rw [Real.log_rpow hb]
        have h₄ : Real.log (c^c) = c * Real.log c := by
          rw [Real.log_rpow hc]
        rw [h₂, h₃, h₄]
        <;> ring
      have h₂ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a+b+c)/3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
        have h₂ : Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) = ((a+b+c)/3) * Real.log (a*b*c) := by

            rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]

        rw [h₃]

      have h₃ : a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c ≥ ((a+b+c)/3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
        
        have h₃ : 0 < a * b := by positivity
        have h₄ : 0 < b * c := by positivity
        have h₅ : 0 < a * c := by positivity
        have h₆ : 0 < a * b * c := by positivity
        
        have h₇ : a * Real.log a + b * Real.log b + c * Real.log c ≥ ((a+b+c)/3) * (Real.log a + Real.log b + Real.log c) := by
          
          have h₇ : (a - b) * (Real.log a - Real.log b) ≥ 0 := by

              have h₁₀ : Real.log b - Real.log a ≥ 0 := by linarith

            have h₈ : b ≥ c ∨ c ≥ b := by

              · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
            cases h₈ with
            | inl h₈ =>
              have h₉ : Real.log b ≥ Real.log c := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h₈
              have h₁₀ : b - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₁ : Real.log b - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith
              nlinarith
            | inr h₈ =>

              have h₁₀ : c - b ≥ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₁ : Real.log c - Real.log b ≥ 0 := by linarith

              have h₁₁ : c - a ≥ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₂ : Real.log c - Real.log a ≥ 0 := by linarith
              nlinarith
            | inr h₉ =>

              have h₁₁ : a - c ≥ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₂ : Real.log a - Real.log c ≥ 0 := by linarith

        exact h₇
      have h₄ : Real.log (a^a * b^b * c^c) ≥ Real.log ((a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3)) := by
        linarith
      have h₅ : a^a * b^b * c^c ≥ (a*b*c)^((a+b+c)/3) := by

          apply Real.log_lt_log (by positivity) h₆
        linarith

def IsGood (x A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  sqrt (x + sqrt (2 * x - 1)) + sqrt (x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)) = A ∧ 0 ≤ 2 * x - 1 ∧
    0 ≤ x + sqrt (2 * x - 1) ∧ 0 ≤ x - sqrt (2 * x - 1)

abbrev solution_set_two : Set ℝ := { 3 / 2 }

        have h₃₀ : x = 3 / 2 := by

        exact h₃₀

    rw [h] at hx
    norm_num at hx <;> simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]
    <;> ring_nf at hx ⊢ <;> nlinarith [sin_sq_add_cos_sq x, sin_le_one x, cos_le_one x, sq_nonneg (sin x + cos x), sq_nonneg (sin x - cos x)]
  
  have hsinx_eq : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
    have h1 : tan x = sin x / cos x := by
      rw [tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    rw [h1] at hx
    have h2 : sin x / cos x = 5 := by
      linarith
    have h3 : sin x = 5 * cos x := by
      field_simp at h2
      linarith
    exact h3
  
  have hcosx_sq : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 26 := by
    have h1 : sin x ^ 2 + cos x ^ 2 = 1 := by
      exact sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
    rw [hsinx_eq] at h1
    ring_nf at h1 ⊢
    nlinarith [sin_le_one x, cos_le_one x, sq_pos_of_ne_zero hcosx_ne_zero]
  
  have hsin2x : sin (2 * x) = 5 / 13 := by
    have h1 : sin (2 * x) = 2 * sin x * cos x := by
      rw [sin_two_mul]
    rw [h1]
    rw [hsinx_eq]
    nlinarith [sin_le_one x, cos_le_one x, sq_nonneg (sin x + cos x), sq_nonneg (sin x - cos x),
      sin_sq_add_cos_sq x]
  
  have hcos2x : cos (2 * x) = -12 / 13 := by

    rw [hcosx_sq]
    <;> ring

    <;> ring
    <;> nlinarith [sin_le_one x, cos_le_one x, sin_sq_add_cos_sq x]

    rw [hcos2x]

    rw [hsin2x, hcos2x]

    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith
  
  have h_final : (6 + sin (2 * x)) / (1 + cos (2 * x)) = solution := by

    have h₃ : (a : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a := by
      have h₄ : (a : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₅ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
      have h₆ : (a : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a := by
        have h₇ : (a : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a := by
          have h₈ : (a : ℝ) ^ n ≤ a ^ 1 := by
            apply pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by positivity) (by linarith) (by
              omega)
          simpa using h₈
        exact h₇
      exact h₆
    have h₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
    linarith
  
  have h_b_gt_one : b > 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : b ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h₂ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
    have h₃ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) ≤ b := by
      have h₄ : (b : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₅ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
      have h₆ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) ≤ b := by
        have h₇ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) ≤ b := by
          have h₈ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) ≤ b ^ 1 := by
            apply pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by positivity) (by linarith) (by
              omega)
          simpa using h₈
        exact h₇
      exact h₆
    have h₄ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = b + 3 * a := by exact_mod_cast hbn
    linarith
  
  have h_b_lt_a : b < a := by
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : b ≥ a := by linarith
    have h₂ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
    have h₃ : a > 1 := h_a_gt_one
    have h₄ : b > 1 := h_b_gt_one
    have h₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 / a := by
      have h₅₁ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
      have h₅₂ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
      have h₅₃ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
      have h₅₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 / a := by
        have h₅₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 / a := by
          have h₅₅₁ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
          have h₅₅₂ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) = (a : ℝ) ^ n / a := by
            cases n with
            | zero => contradiction 
            | succ n =>
              cases n with
              | zero => contradiction 
              | succ n =>
                simp [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, pow_add, pow_one, Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le]
                <;> field_simp
                <;> ring_nf
                <;> field_simp
                <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₅₅₂]
          have h₅₅₃ : (a : ℝ) ^ n / a = (a + 1 : ℝ) / a := by rw [h₅₅₁]
          rw [h₅₅₃]
          have h₅₅₄ : (a + 1 : ℝ) / a = 1 + 1 / a := by
            field_simp
            <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₅₅₄]
        exact h₅₅
      exact h₅₄
    have h₆ : (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) > 4 := by
      have h₆₁ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 / a := h₅
      have h₆₂ : (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) = (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) * (a : ℝ) ^ n := by
        have h₆₃ : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) = (n - 1 : ℕ) + n := by
          cases n with
          | zero => contradiction
          | succ n =>
            cases n with
            | zero => contradiction
            | succ n =>
              simp [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> omega
        rw [h₆₃]
        have h₆₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ ((n - 1 : ℕ) + n) = (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1 : ℕ) * (a : ℝ) ^ n := by
          rw [pow_add]
        rw [h₆₄]
      rw [h₆₂, h₆₁]
      have h₆₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
      rw [h₆₅]
      have h₆₆ : (1 + 1 / a : ℝ) * (a + 1) > 4 := by
        have h₆₇ : 0 < a := ha
        have h₆₈ : 0 < 1 / a := by positivity
        have h₆₉ : 0 < a + 1 := by linarith
        have h₇₀ : 0 < (1 / a : ℝ) * (a + 1) := by positivity
        field_simp
        rw [← sub_pos]
        field_simp
        ring_nf
        nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (a - 1)]
      linarith
    have h₇ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by
      have h₇₁ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = b + 3 * a := by exact_mod_cast hbn
      have h₇₂ : (b : ℝ) ≥ a := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₇₃ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by
        have h₇₄ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = b + 3 * a := by exact_mod_cast hbn
        have h₇₅ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) ≤ 4 * b := by
          have h₇₅₁ : (a : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast h₁
          have h₇₅₂ : (b : ℝ) + 3 * a ≤ b + 3 * b := by
            nlinarith
          nlinarith
        have h₇₆ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by
          have h₇₇ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by
            have h₇₈ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) * (b : ℝ) ≤ 4 * b := by
              have h₇₉ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) * (b : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) := by
                have h₈₀ : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 * n := by
                  have h₈₁ : n ≥ 2 := hn
                  have h₈₂ : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) + 1 = 2 * n := by
                    cases n with
                    | zero => contradiction
                    | succ n =>
                      cases n with
                      | zero => contradiction
                      | succ n =>
                        simp [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc]
                        <;> ring_nf at *
                        <;> omega
                  exact h₈₂
                have h₈₃ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) * (b : ℝ) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) + 1) := by
                  rw [← pow_succ]
                  <;> simp [h₈₀]
                rw [h₈₃, h₈₀]
              rw [h₇₉]
              nlinarith
            have h₈₄ : (b : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
            have h₈₅ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 4 := by
              by_contra h₈₅₁
              have h₈₅₂ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) > 4 := by linarith
              have h₈₅₃ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) * (b : ℝ) > 4 * b := by
                nlinarith
              linarith
            exact h₈₅
          exact h₇₇
        exact h₇₆
      exact h₇₃
    have h₈ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≥ (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) := by
      have h₈₁ : (b : ℝ) ≥ a := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₈₂ : (b : ℝ) > 1 := by exact_mod_cast h_b_gt_one
      have h₈₃ : (a : ℝ) > 1 := by exact_mod_cast h_a_gt_one
      have h₈₄ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≥ (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) := by
        exact pow_le_pow_of_le_left (by positivity) h₈₁ _
      exact h₈₄
    have h₉ : (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) > 4 := by exact h₆
    have h₁₀ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) > 4 := by linarith
    linarith
  
  have h_main : b < a := by
    exact h_b_lt_a
  
  simp_all
  <;> aesop

abbrev a_is_larger : ℕ → Bool := fun _ ↦ true

theorem usa1993_p1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (han : a^n = a + 1) (hbn : b^(2 * n) = b + 3 * a) :
    if a_is_larger n then b < a else a < b := by 
  have h_a_ge_one : a ≥ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    
    have h₁ : a < 1 := by linarith
    have h₂ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
    have h₃ : (a : ℝ) ^ n < a := by
      have h₄ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
      have h₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ n < a := by
        have h₆ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
        have h₇ : (a : ℝ) ^ n < a := by
          have h₈ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) < 1 := by
            have h₉ : (a : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₁
            have h₁₀ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) < 1 := by
              exact pow_lt_one (by positivity) h₉ (by
                have h₁₁ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
                have h₁₂ : (n : ℕ) - 1 ≥ 1 := by
                  omega
                omega)
            exact h₁₀
          have h₁₁ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * a := by
            have h₁₂ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
            have h₁₃ : (n : ℕ) - 1 + 1 = n := by
              omega
            calc
              (a : ℝ) ^ n = (a : ℝ) ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by
                rw [h₁₃]
              _ = (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * a := by
                rw [pow_succ]
                <;> ring
          rw [h₁₁]
          have h₁₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * a < a := by
            have h₁₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) < 1 := h₈
            have h₁₆ : 0 < a := ha
            nlinarith
          exact h₁₄
        exact h₇
      exact h₅
    have h₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
    linarith
  
  have h_a_gt_one : a > 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : a ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h₂ : a = 1 := by
      have h₃ : a ≥ 1 := h_a_ge_one
      have h₄ : a ≤ 1 := h₁
      linarith
    rw [h₂] at han
    have h₅ : (1 : ℝ) ^ n = 1 + 1 := by
      norm_num at han ⊢
      <;>
      (try norm_num) <;>
      (try linarith) <;>
      (try simp_all [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_add, pow_one, mul_comm]) <;>
      (try ring_nf at *) <;>
      (try nlinarith) <;>
      (try linarith)
      <;>
      (try nlinarith)
    have h₆ : (1 : ℝ) ^ n = 1 := by
      simp [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_add, pow_one, mul_comm]
    linarith
  
  have h_b_lt_a : b < a := by
    by_contra h
    have h₁ : b ≥ a := by linarith
    have h₂ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≥ a + 2 + 1 / a := by
      have h₃ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 + 1 / a := by
        have h₄ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
        have h₅ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 + 1 / a := by
          have h₆ : (n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := hn
          have h₇ : (n : ℕ) - 1 + 1 = n := by
            omega
          have h₈ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * a = a + 1 := by
            calc
              (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * a = (a : ℝ) ^ ((n - 1) + 1) := by
                rw [← pow_succ]
                <;> simp [h₇]
              _ = (a : ℝ) ^ n := by rw [h₇]
              _ = a + 1 := by rw [han]
          have h₉ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 + 1 / a := by
            have h₁₀ : (a : ℝ) > 0 := ha
            field_simp at h₈ ⊢
            nlinarith
          exact h₉
        exact h₅
      have h₄ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≥ a + 2 + 1 / a := by
        have h₅ : (b : ℝ) ≥ a := by exact_mod_cast h₁
        have h₆ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≥ a ^ (2 * n - 1) := by
          exact pow_le_pow_of_le_left (by positivity) h₅ _
        have h₇ : (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≥ a + 2 + 1 / a := by
          have h₈ : (a : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) = (a : ℝ) ^ (n + (n - 1)) := by
            have h₉ : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) = n + (n - 1) := by
              have h₁₀ : n ≥ 2 := hn
              cases n with
              | zero => omega
              | succ n =>
                cases n with
                | zero => omega
                | succ n =>
                  simp [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.add_assoc]
                  <;> ring_nf at *
                  <;> omega
            rw [h₉]
            <;> simp [pow_add]
            <;> ring_nf
            <;> field_simp
            <;> ring_nf
          rw [h₈]
          have h₉ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n + (n - 1)) = (a : ℝ) ^ n * (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) := by
            rw [pow_add]
          rw [h₉]
          have h₁₀ : (a : ℝ) ^ n = a + 1 := by exact_mod_cast han
          have h₁₁ : (a : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) = 1 + 1 / a := by exact h₃
          rw [h₁₀, h₁₁]
          have h₁₂ : 0 < a := ha
          field_simp
          rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (a + 1)]
        linarith
      exact h₄
    have h₃ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≤ 4 := by
      have h₄ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = b + 3 * a := by exact_mod_cast hbn
      have h₅ : (b : ℝ) ≥ a := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₆ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) * b := by
        have h₇ : (2 * n : ℕ) ≥ 2 := by
          have h₈ : n ≥ 2 := hn
          omega
        have h₈ : (2 * n : ℕ) - 1 + 1 = 2 * n := by
          omega
        calc
          (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n) = (b : ℝ) ^ ((2 * n - 1) + 1) := by
            rw [h₈]
          _ = (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) * b := by
            rw [pow_succ]
            <;> ring_nf
      rw [h₆] at h₄
      have h₇ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) * b = b + 3 * a := by linarith
      have h₈ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≤ 4 := by
        have h₉ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) * b = b + 3 * a := by linarith
        have h₁₀ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) * b ≤ 4 * b := by
          nlinarith [h_a_ge_one, h_a_gt_one, h₁, ha, hb]
        have h₁₁ : (b : ℝ) ^ (2 * n - 1) ≤ 4 := by
          nlinarith [h₁, ha, hb]
        exact h₁₁
      exact h₈
    have h₄ : (a : ℝ) + 2 + 1 / a > 4 := by
      have h₅ : (a : ℝ) > 1 := by exact_mod_cast h_a_gt_one
      have h₆ : (a : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      rw [← sub_pos]
      field_simp
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((a : ℝ) - 1), sq_nonneg ((a : ℝ) + 1)]
    linarith
  
  have h_main : (if a_is_larger n then b < a else a < b) := by
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [a_is_larger]
    <;> try contradiction
    <;> try linarith
    <;> try nlinarith
  
  exact h_main

theorem usa1980_p5 (x y z : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
    (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤
    1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by 
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ x := by
    exact hx.1

  have h₂ : x ≤ 1 := by
    exact hx.2

  have h₃ : 0 ≤ y := by
    exact hy.1

  have h₄ : y ≤ 1 := by
    exact hy.2

  have h₅ : 0 ≤ z := by
    exact hz.1

  have h₆ : z ≤ 1 := by
    exact hz.2

  have h₇ : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 := by
    have h₇₁ : 0 ≤ x * y := by positivity
    have h₇₂ : 0 ≤ y * z := by positivity
    have h₇₃ : 0 ≤ z * x := by positivity
    have h₇₄ : 0 ≤ x * y * z := by positivity
    have h₇₅ : 0 ≤ x * y * z * x := by positivity
    have h₇₆ : 0 ≤ x * y * z * y := by positivity
    have h₇₇ : 0 ≤ x * y * z * z := by positivity
    field_simp
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₂),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₃) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₄),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₆),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₃),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₂) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₄),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₂) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₆),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₃) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₄) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₆)]

  have h₈ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
    have h₈₁ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) := by linarith
    have h₈₂ : 0 ≤ (1 - y) := by linarith
    have h₈₃ : 0 ≤ (1 - z) := by linarith
    have h₈₄ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) := by positivity
    have h₈₅ : 0 ≤ (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by positivity
    linarith

  have h₉ : x / (y + z + 1) + y / (z + x + 1) + z / (x + y + 1) ≤ 1 + (1 - x) * (1 - y) * (1 - z) := by
    linarith

  exact h₉
